name: Chemical cleaning and passivation of new boilers (pre-commissioning)
description: Remove welding slag, iron oxides, grease and construction debris from a newly built boiler before start-up; then form a protective magnetite film (passivation) to minimise corrosion and pitting during commissioning and lay-up.
